summary.tldr: Requires the Finance Minister to table an open banking implementation plan and, if needed, explain delays in introducing a related bill.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Finance to table a plan for implementing open banking in Canada within 30 days after the Act comes into force, or within the first 10 sitting days of the next House sitting if needed.
Requires the Minister of Finance to table a report if no open banking bill has been introduced within six months, setting out the reasons for the delay and the expected timeline.
summary.background: The bill concerns the implementation of open banking in Canada and sets deadlines for ministerial reporting.
